lines: This is Molecule Studio: a place to explore and build molecules, right in your browser.
Type the name of a molecule, like caffeine, and it appears in 3D.
Drag to turn it, and scroll to zoom.
Click any atom to see what it is.
In edit mode, you can change it.
Click to add a carbon, and its hydrogens appear on their own.
Drag out a bond: green means it's allowed, red means that atom is already full.
Let go, and one click tidies up the shape.
It works for big molecules too, like this protein with a drug bound inside.
Show its surface, color it by how water-loving each part is, and look right through it.
Molecule Studio. Explore, inspect and build.
